description: Docked Chrome DevTools divider drag (devtools-resize-live.py --background, cx-d0d.45): a Chromium tab on a local page with DevTools docked, its divider dragged in the app (debug.mouse, the window not key) in two tabs and DevTools closed and reopened; how far each drag's new DevTools size is from the drag (points) and the failed checks (the drag resizes by about the drag, sizes stay per tab and across a reopen), light session.
